gpu_dma_policy: Monitor is a passive GPU/DMA preview consumer. Active Broadcast Player preview must use the caller-supplied DMA/GPU descriptor. CPU RGBA fallback and thumbnail-as-monitor fallback are disabled unless a later explicit decision re-enables them.
boundary: Paints a caller-supplied GPU/DMA preview descriptor status, message, or placeholder. Any application may embed it. It does not own the player clock, fetch pixels, decode media, read a database, convert thumbnails, or know the host application.
